data.standardized_narrative: Gross prior year claims reserves strengthened by GBP 23.0m, representing 3.98% of opening gross reserves. This calculation is derived from the gross claims development triangle. While the report's narrative highlights an overall improvement in net underwriting performance and a major improvement in net loss ratio from prior years, primarily due to improved risk selection, product mix, and reduced claims frequencies from COVID-19 lockdowns, the gross claims development shows a strengthening. This suggests that while net reserves may have released (as indicated by a 'Net claims release' of GBP 6.707m in a specific note), gross reserves required strengthening. This was partially offset by higher claims costs due to economic inflation in used car prices.
